compute.cost_note: stdlib only; reads existing JSON, runs no new measurement

do_not_use_when: you want the interpretation written for you; the script deliberately leaves interpretive markers
you have not run voice_profile yet (--voice-profile is required)

examples.description: Report from a profile plus a drift run

inputs.target: voice_profile JSON plus optional drift and idiolect JSON

artifacts: Markdown voice insights report (stdout or --out; file outputs must sit under ai-prose-baselines-private/ unless --allow-public-output)

purpose: Populate a voice insights report from existing voice_profile, voice_drift_tracker and idiolect_detector JSON outputs, following references/templates/voice_insights_report.template.md. Numerical sections are filled programmatically; interpretive sections are left as {TODO: interpret: <hint>} markers for a human or LLM editor, so the script writes no prose readings.
use_when: you have voice_profile (and optionally drift and idiolect) JSON and want a structured report draft
comparing your drift against a control writer's drift (--comparison-drift)
